source.title: Mtaala wa Shule ya Junia — Kiswahili, Gredi ya Saba (Junior School Curriculum Design — Kiswahili, Grade 7)
source.notes: Read in full via the Read tool (no pages param). ISBN 978-9914-43-937-3, First Published 2022, Revised 2024. Backfilled retroactively after web/src/skills/kiswahiliG7/ (41 skill files) already shipped — see CURRICULUM-MINING-GUIDE.md's standing rule to write this file BEFORE dispatching build agents next time. Design is organised by 15 topical strands (usafi wa kibinafsi, lishe bora, uhuru wa wanyama, aina za maliasili, unyanyasaji wa kijinsia, usalama shuleni, kuhudumia jamii shuleni, ulaguzi wa binadamu, matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali, kijithamini, majukumu ya watoto, magonjwa ambukizi, utatuzi wa mizozo, matumizi ya pesa, maadili ya mtu binafsi), each broken into exactly 4 mada ndogo (sub-strands) covering the 4 language skill areas: 1.x Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza (listening/speaking), 2.x Kusoma (reading), 3.x Kuandika (writing), 4.x Sarufi (grammar) — every mada ndogo is 2 vipindi (lessons), 120 vipindi total. This numbering-by-skill-area repeats within every strand, so this JSON preserves the design's own strand.subStrand numbering (e.g. '1.1.1', '2.4.1') rather than renumbering. Text fields are verbatim Kiswahili from the source, per the mining guide. Assessment: the design uses ONE shared rubric per skill area (Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza / Kusoma / Kuandika / Sarufi), not a per-sub-strand rubric — captured once here as 'sharedAssessmentRubrics' at the end rather than duplicated 60 times; assessmentSignal is populated per sub-strand only where a specific rubric row calls out a behaviour beyond the bare outcome text. Because many mada ndogo types recur verbatim across strands (e.g. 'Kusoma kwa Ufasaha' in strands 4 and 12; 'Ufupisho' in strands 7 and 15; 'Insha za Kubuni: Masimulizi' in strands 4 and 9; 'Ngeli na Upatanisho wa Kisarufi' in strands 8 and 9), the 41 shipped skill files consolidate some repeated types into one skill rather than mapping 1:1 to all 60 mada ndogo — skillFiles is therefore omitted per sub-strand here (unlike the Grade 6 Agriculture template) since the mapping is many-to-many and would misrepresent a 1:1 correspondence that doesn't exist; auditing that mapping is a separate task from this content-breadth backfill. All 15 strands / 60 sub-strands mined in full below.

sharedAssessmentRubrics.note: The design places ONE rubric table per skill area (not per sub-strand), immediately after all 15 strands.
